opening.argument: The video ties paid OneCoin packages to earnings from direct sales and a network that can extend 100 levels down. Its slides show a 5030-euro Tycoon package converted into One coins and project values of 5 euros, then 50 or 100 euros over three years. Those projections accompany an urgent appeal not to ignore the opportunity, followed by a direct request to partner with the team today. Taken together, the tiered recruitment commissions, speculative appreciation claims, and direct solicitation establish a paid recruitment opportunity presented with repeated earnings assurances. Disclaimers do not outweigh that solicitation.
